instruction: Enable GIMP's autosave feature to automatically save recovery files every 5 minutes.

metadata.explanation: This task requires enabling autosave with 5-minute interval (300 seconds). The evaluator checks both 'undo-autosave yes' and 'undo-autosave-interval 300' settings in gimprc. Requires custom metric to check two related settings.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator checks both required settings (autosave enabled and 5-minute interval)
Correct getter logic: Retrieves gimprc file from standard GIMP config location (~/.config/GIMP/2.10/gimprc)
Correct metric logic: Properly parses gimprc format (handles parentheses, comments), checks both 'undo-autosave' and 'undo-autosave-interval' settings
Correct expected values: 300 seconds correctly represents 5 minutes
Appropriate postconfig: Closes GIMP with Ctrl+Q to ensure settings are written to disk
Robust parsing: Handles edge cases (comments, whitespace, empty lines)
Correct scoring: Returns 1.0 only when both settings match (all-or-nothing is appropriate for this task)
